name: calculator
description: Evaluate mathematical expressions safely. Supports arithmetic, trigonometry, statistics, and unit conversions.

manual.overview: Use when you need to evaluate math expressions safely—arithmetic, trigonometry, statistics, unit conversions. Safer than raw eval.
tips: Use Python math syntax: sqrt, sin, cos, log, pi, e
Chain operations; avoid shell injection by using this tool instead of terminal
For unit conversions, use explicit formulas (e.g., miles * 1.609 for km)
edge_cases: Division by zero or invalid expressions raise errors
Very large numbers may overflow or produce inf

executor.command: python -c "import math; result = eval('{{args.expression}}', {'__builtins__': {}}, vars(math)); print(result)"
